content: Ĩ macʉ sʉorine ĩ ocare Dios ĩ gotimasiore queti

Tirʉ̃mʉjʉ cojoji me mani ñicʉare Hebreo masare ĩnare gotimasioñuju Dios. Ĩre gotirẽtobosariarã sʉorine ĩnare gotimasiñuju ĩ. Ĩna gotise rĩ me ĩnare yimasiomasiñuju. Gajeye quẽne, ricati ĩnare ĩ yiroticõamasire rãca ĩnare yimasiomasiñujarã. To bajiri, “To bajiro tʉoĩagʉ̃ ñagʉ̃mi”, yimasiñujarã ĩna, mani ñicʉa.

To bajiri yucʉrirema, Dios ĩ macʉre manire ĩ cõajare, quẽnaro Diore masiaja mani. Macarʉcʉro, õ vecaye ñajediro ĩ macʉ sʉorine tire rujeomasiñuju Dios. Ĩ macʉne ñaami, “Jediro macarʉcʉroayere cʉorʉcʉja mʉ” ĩ yimasir'i.

Dios macʉre ajitirʉ̃nʉrã ĩre masirã ñari, “Rẽtoro ñamasugʉ̃ ñagʉ̃mi Dios”, yimasiaja mani. Diore masirã ñarãma ĩ macʉre masirã. Ĩ macʉre quẽnaro masicõari, “Ĩ jacʉre bajirone bajigʉ ñagʉ̃mi”, yimasiaja mani. Ĩ macʉne ñaami, “Adi macarʉcʉroaye bajimʉorʉ̃gõato” yirotimasir'i. Ĩne ñaami, Diore ajitirʉ̃nʉrã rojose mani yise vaja manire rijabosacõari, Diorãca ñajedirore rotigʉ.
“Ángel mesa rẽtoro ñamasugʉ̃ ñaami Dios macʉ”, yire queti
To bajiri adirʉ̃mʉri Diorãca rotigʉ ñari, Diore moabosarã ángel mesare rẽtoro ñamasugʉ̃ ñaami Dios macʉ.
Ĩ sĩgʉ̃ne ñamasugʉ̃ ĩ ñajare, ado bajise ĩre yiyumi Dios:

content.text: “Adirʉ̃mʉne yʉ macʉ ñari, yʉre bajiro rotisʉorʉcʉja mʉ”, ĩre yimasiñuju Dios.

content: Ángel mesarema, to bajiro ĩnare yibesumi Dios. Gãjerãre quẽne, ti ũnire yibecʉne ĩ macʉ sĩgʉ̃rene tʉoĩagʉ̃, ado bajiro yiyumi Dios:

content.text: “Ĩ jacʉ ñaja yʉ. To bajiri yʉ macʉ ñaami”, ĩre yiyumi.

content: Ĩ macʉ ñamasugʉ̃re, adi macarʉcʉrojʉre ĩre cõagʉ̃, ado bajise ĩre yiyumi:

content.text: “Ángel mesa quẽne mʉre rʉ̃cʉbʉo jedicõarʉarãma ĩna”, yiyumi Dios.

content: Ĩre moabosarimasa ángel mesare yigʉ, ado bajiro yiyumi Dios:

content.text: “Ángel mesare yʉ rotijama, yoaro me mino ti vẽatuvasere bajiro yoaro mene yʉre cʉdirʉarãma. To yicõari, jea ʉ̃jʉse guaro ti ʉ̃jʉjẽnirore bajiro yʉre moabosarʉarãma ĩna”, yiyumi Dios, ángel mesa ĩre ĩna moabosarotire yigʉ.

content: Ĩ macʉ ñamasugʉ̃re yigʉ, ado bajirojʉa yiyumi Dios:

content.text: “Yʉ macʉ ñari, Dios ñaja mʉ. Mʉ rotise jedibetirʉaroja. Masare mʉ rotijama, yʉ bojarore bajirone quẽnaro rotirʉcʉja mʉ.

‘Yʉ bojarore bajiro quẽnaro yigʉ, rojosejʉarema yibetirʉcʉja’ yitʉoĩarũgũcajʉ mʉ. To bajiro yicacʉ mʉ ñajare, ‘Gãjerã rẽtoro ñamasugʉ̃ ñaja’ mʉre yaja yʉ. To bajiro mʉre yʉ yijare, bʉto variquẽnaja mʉ”, yiyumi Dios, ĩ macʉre.

content: Quẽna gajeye ado bajise yiyumi Dios, ĩ macʉre yigʉ:

content.text: Mʉ rujeomasicati jedirone ti jedicoaboajaquẽne, mʉjʉama, ñacõa ñarũgũrocʉ ñaja mʉ, Dios ñari.

Sudi ĩna sãñasʉosere vejecõari, gajeye quẽnase ĩna vasoasãñarore bajiro, adi macarʉcʉro ñase ti jedirore quẽna gajeye vasoarʉcʉja mʉ. Mʉma, rijabetirocʉ ñari, mʉne ñacõa ñarũgũrʉcʉja mʉ”, ĩ macʉre yiyumi Dios.

content: Quẽna, ĩ macʉ sĩgʉ̃rene ado bajise yirʉ̃cʉbʉoyumi Dios:

content.text: “Rʉ̃cʉbʉoriajaʉre rujiya maji. Mʉre ĩaterãre, ‘Rojose yitʉjaya’ ĩnare yʉ yiro bero, rojose yimasibetirʉarãma. To cõrone rotisʉorʉcʉja mʉ”, yirʉ̃cʉbʉoyumi Dios, ĩ macʉre.

content: Ángel mesarema, to bajiro yibetimasiñuju Dios.
Ángel mesama, ruyumena ĩre moabosarã ĩ cõarã ñarãma. To bajiri, Diore ajitirʉ̃nʉrã õ vecajʉ quẽnaro ĩ rãca ñaronare ejarẽmorã ñarãma ángel mesa.
